papers.title: Hard and Soft Real-Time DNN Inference Scheduling on Heterogeneous Multi-Accelerator Systems via Reinforcement Learning
authors: Francesco Giulio Blanco, Enrico Russo, Giuseppe Ascia, Davide Patti, Maurizio Palesi
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2610.29503v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: We present a scheduling framework for heterogeneous multi-accelerator systems executing both hard real-time and soft real-time QoS-aware DNN inference workloads. The framework combines an online reinforcement learning (RL) scheduler with a deterministic runtime safety layer. The RL scheduler dynamically generates candidate schedules by jointly selecting sub-job priorities and accelerator assignments, while runtime certification guarantees that all HRT deadlines remain satisfied independently of the learned policy.

papers.title: VHDLBench: Benchmarking and Fine-Tuning Large Language Models for VHDL-Based Chip Design
authors: Patrik Drazic, Benaoumeur Senouci, Boualem Benatallah
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2610.28676v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: The rapid evolution of digital circuit complexity demands innovative approaches to hardware design automation. While Large Language Models (LLMs) have influenced software development, their application to Hardware Description Language (HDL) generation remains largely unexplored, particularly for VHDL. This paper presents a comprehensive study for AI-assisted digital circuit design, addressing gaps in current Electronic Design Automation workflows. The work introduces a VHDL dataset of 18,500+ syntax-verified examples from open-source repositories and converted Verilog designs.
